name: with-shadowed-slots
source:
events=[]
class C:
 def __enter__(self):events.append('class-enter');return self
 def __exit__(self,*args):events.append('class-exit')
c=C()
c.__enter__=lambda:events.append('instance-enter')
c.__exit__=lambda *args:events.append('instance-exit')
with c:events.append('body')
print(events)
